record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, replace each GRU state's readout with 0.75 times that state plus 0.25 times a causal, exponentially weighted mean of nonpadding GRU states through that position, using half-life 3 interactions. Apply this identically at training positions and the final real inference position. Recent-state pooling may retain useful short-term interests without learned pooling parameters. Preserve history length, GRU backbone, embeddings, scoring, loss and optimizer; update the predictor writer consistently.

category_rationales.rationale: Blend each GRU state with a causal exponential mean of observed, nonpadding states: 75% current state and 25% pooled state, with half-life three interactions. Apply the same readout during training and inference across all four categories. Preserve recurrent topology, embeddings, scoring, loss, optimizer and history length; checkpoint the readout settings and restore them through the predictor writer.
